key_points.point: Cem Karsan expects a 25% to 40% market decline starting in late 2026 or early 2027 and completing between March and June 2027.
Hyper-scaler AI CapEx spending and massive debt issuance are depleting cash reserves and crowding out sovereign debt markets.
The Strait of Hormuz closure will persist for a year or more, imposing structurally higher costs across the global economy.
Structural option dealer flows and volatility compression dictate a stair-step market decline into December Opex.
The Federal Reserve is currently engaging in credibility theater but will inevitably pivot to aggressive rate cuts and money printing within 7 to 8 months.
Recommends buying long-dated gold call options and selling oil put options to position for the upcoming commodity macro cycle over the next 6 to 9 months.
Equity market declines accompanied by compressed index volatility tend to cut deeper and inflict more pain than high-VIX panic crashes.
Projects the S&P 500 will bottom between 5,000 and 5,900 by June 2027 before staging a significant recovery.
Forecasts WTI crude oil will drop to the $50s-$60s on demand weakness before spiking back up to $130-$140.
Anticipates 10-year Treasury yields will temporarily dip to 3.8%-3.9% before rebounding sharply to 5.5%-6.0%.
